about-me.title: Who?
about-me.intro: I am a front-end-focused software developer with {{year}} years of experience in developing modern web and mobile applications. My expertise is centered on user-driven development, emphasizing clarity, simplicity, and a smooth user experience.
about-me.middle: I focus on responsive and carefully designed user interfaces that are intuitive for users. My technical skills combined with an eye for design make me a developer who builds interfaces that are not only functional but also visually appealing.

skills.studies-article: After a long career in factory work, I decided to change my career path and started studying programming. At Karelia, I gained a solid foundation in data structures, logic, and a variety of technologies and tools used in software development.
skills.internship-article: Midway through my studies, I got my first internship at Sensire. This Joensuu-based company, specialized in temperature monitoring and quality control, gave me a clear understanding of what software development and teamwork mean in real-world work environments.
skills.employed-article: At the end of my internship, I was offered to continue working at Sensire. Alongside my studies, this provided an excellent opportunity to further develop my skills and apply the knowledge gained from my education in practice.
skills.graduation-article: While working, I completed my studies, and upon graduation, I felt fortunate at how quickly I had gained a new career readiness while also accumulating work experience. I now continue working at Sensire, where I can further develop my skills and apply what I have learned in practice.
